appWeb.contactText: Ready to take your ideas to the next level? Let's talk about how I can add value to your next project or creative collaboration.
appWeb.about: I'm a Frontend developer with over 3 years of experience building administrative web applications and custom digital solutions using React, Next.js, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS. I specialize in developing modern, functional and scalable interfaces, ensuring consistent, high-quality experiences. I've built complete modules such as authentication, user management, master catalogs, dynamic tables with advanced filters and document uploads. My approach combines frontend architecture best practices, component optimization and collaborative work in agile environments. My goal is to contribute to robust and efficient digital products, aligning technical needs with user experience and business goals.
appWeb.projectsDisclaimer: * The projects listed above represent my participation in initiatives carried out throughout my professional career, described in general terms to respect each company's confidentiality.

prevalentware.title: Custom Application Developer
prevalentware.description: I built complete administrative interfaces for enterprise products, covering key features such as login, sign-up, password recovery, user management, file handling and master catalog administration. I specialized in integrating the frontend with REST APIs and external services, ensuring smooth, efficient and secure communication with internal systems. I also improved the architecture by creating reusable, responsive components with React and Tailwind CSS, increasing maintainability and visual consistency across projects. All of this was backed by sound architecture, documentation and version control practices, enabling teamwork and contributing to successful agile development cycles.

freelance.title: Junior Web Developer
freelance.description: I worked as a junior web developer, focusing on building landing pages and corporate websites with HTML, CSS, JavaScript and responsive design. I specialized in customizing WordPress sites with Elementor and specialized plugins, delivering solutions tailored to each client's specific needs. I also optimized site performance to improve load times and the mobile experience, leading to higher user satisfaction. All of this was backed by good maintenance, update and continuous improvement practices, ensuring the visual and functional consistency of the websites.

cabi.title: Teacher
cabi.description: I worked as a teacher, focusing on teaching programming fundamentals and IT tools to software development technical students. I specialized in implementing teaching strategies focused on hands-on learning, helping students develop technical and professional skills. I also led training projects in partnership with SENA, applying my knowledge in a real context and contributing to community development. All of this was backed by good teaching, research and collaboration practices, ensuring the quality and relevance of the educational programs.

riskhub.name: RiskHub
riskhub.description: Advanced query-param-based filters for dynamic queries. i18n internationalization with multi-language support in Next.js. UX optimization for visualizing maps, layers and models.

lacea.name: LACEA web portal (Admin panel)
lacea.description: Admin panel for managing user memberships. Publishing system for professional offers and opportunities for members. Internal search to find active members — enabling networking and collaboration.

portalAliados.name: PortalAliados
portalAliados.description: Multi-step forms with conditional fields based on answers. HubSpot integration for automatic lead registration. Dynamic validations and optimized UX for the data capture flow.

ctrlCash.name: Ctrl Cash
ctrlCash.description: Web app for tracking expenses and budgets. Lets you record, categorize and visualize financial transactions efficiently and in an organized way.

rickAndMorty.name: Searching - Rick and Morty
rickAndMorty.description: Web app to search for characters from the Rick and Morty series. Shows character information such as name, image, species, gender, location and the episodes they appear in.

cvLoneliness.name: CV loneliness
cvLoneliness.description: Interactive résumé web app built with Angular that lets you view, download and share a professional CV with multi-language support (Spanish/English).

leonardoDaVinci.name: Colegio Gimnasio Leonardo da Vinci
leonardoDaVinci.description: Website for the Gimnasio Leonardo da Vinci school, built with WordPress and Elementor.

jveloperCv.name: Jveloper CV
jveloperCv.description: An interactive résumé with a modern Windows 11-inspired interface, built with the latest web technologies. This project combines a functional operating-system design with professional information in an innovative and engaging way.
